scoring_justification: Radial rotation consistency (arctan(Sx/Sz) vs reported theta_norm) recomputed from agent's raw CSV, plus reference_match at key B_x points with tolerance 0.1; monotonicity check for continuous reorientation. T1 recompute of rotation relation verifies self-consistency, while reference_match anchors the curve shape to paper-reported behavior.

output_contract.notes: Each CSV must contain at least 20 rows uniformly spanning the specified B_x range. The checker compares each agent-reported value to hidden reference values digitised from the paper's figures. An absolute tolerance of 0.05 is applied for every component. For the K2=0.5 case, the checker also verifies that theta_norm is monotonically non-decreasing, confirming a continuous reorientation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference magnetization and angle values at selected B_x points for two parameter sets, derived from digitized data of paper Figures 1 and 2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figures 1 (K2=0.2,T=100) and 2 (K2=0.5,T=4.9); values sampled at regular interval and smoothed to approximate the theoretical curves
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized approximate values from published figures, interpolated to smooth functional form, then sampled at chosen B_x points
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are based on the original published curves and consistent with the physical model
